queries:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
)
SELECT MediaTypeId, avg_price / (SELECT AVG(avg_price) FROM g) AS Ratio
FROM g;
SELECT m.Name, t.avg_ms / (SELECT AVG(a.avg_ms) FROM (SELECT AVG(t2.Milliseconds) AS avg_ms FROM MediaType m2 LEFT JOIN Track t2 ON t2.MediaTypeId = m2.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m2.MediaTypeId) a) AS ratio
FROM MediaType m
LEFT JOIN (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(Milliseconds) AS avg_ms FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId) t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
SELECT m.Name
FROM MediaType m
JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
HAVING AVG(t.UnitPrice) > (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track);
